lines: Unlocked Secret Seeds can now be toggled on and off via a new menu, accessed through the Secret Seed button.
You can bulk buy and craft items in batches of 10 by holding Left Shift.
You can now craft Pine Platforms from Pine Wood as well as Pine Tree blocks.
Leashed kites and placed critters no longer break if they lack an anchor.
Toybreaker Bricks now break Release Lanterns.
Renamed the This is Canon Now painting to Brasilian Skies.
The Constant + Skyblock seed worlds no longer display the Radio Thing's effect by default.
Added 1.4.5's resprited sand piles' old versions to the Rubblemaker.
Bad luck no longer breaks watches.
The special rules for worlds with few blocks now (retroactively) only apply to worlds that were generated with the Skyblock seed.
Fully Restored Whip's hitbox to match 1.4.4's, and adjusted the backswing's visuals to match it (The swing now always collides as if its up-to-down, for damage consistency).
Improved Mushroom Staff's damage from 5 to 8. We're still keeping an eye on it.
Improved Thunder Zapper's damage from 20 to 24.
Reduced Flinx Fur Staff's Flinx Fur cost from 10 to 6 (same as pre-1.4.5).
Clouds can now be mined twice as fast.
Optimized Spore Sac's code in multiplayer.
Fixed villagers refusing to arrive if Truffle is homeless. (Yes, It was Truffle all along.)
Fixed inputs sometimes not registering when playing at a low framerate.
Fixed worlds failing to due to a bug involving placed critters (affected worlds are fine and will now load successfully).
Fixed the Screen Shake option's value not persisting between sessions.
Fixed quick stacking items to nearby chests in multiplayer not making those items available for other players who have craft from nearby chests enabled.
Fixed the Chain Knife not being dropped in pre-Hardmode.
Fixed a crash caused by the Book Worm achievement.
Fixed Pine Wood blocks sometimes being invisible.
Fixed a typo in the Logic Gate (XOR)'s tooltip.
Fixed several cases in which the Dungeon entrance would be on a Floating Island.
Fixed Sandstorm visuals not appearing in Crimson or Hallow Deserts.
Fixed the Empress of Light's Treasure Bag dropping 1 Prismatic Dye instead of 3.
Fixed being unable to quick-equip the Reindeer Bells.
Fixed a number of fences not having any map colors, and improved the colors of some of the fences that did.
Fixed a missing pixel in Master Mode's defense counter.
Fixed Snow biome's Aurora effect not fading out when returning to the title screen.
Fixed Roller Skates erroneously granting immunity to fire blocks.
Fixed exploit involving Roller Skates and wings.
Fixed the Skyblock seed not granting the A Rare Realm achievement.
Fixed Digtoise not disappearing during the Old One's Army event.
Fixed several localization errors.
Fixed the inventory UI becoming unresponsive if autopause is enabled when opening the inventory while using an item.
Fixed the Snowball Launcher missing its "Wireable" tooltip.
Fixed an item duplication exploit involving transformation mounts.
Fixed the Chillet mounts being able to move through solid blocks.
Fixed an exploit involving high mining speeds and certain melee weapons.
Fixed several multiplayer issues on Skyblock worlds.
Fixed erroneous messages appearing when playing on the Endless Christmas secret seed.
Fixed the Hallowed biome's background rainbow sometimes flickering when moving.
Fixed an issue where placing Hallowed blocks in certain biomes could sometimes break the background.
Fixed the craft buttons overlapping the chest inventory at certain UI scales when using gamepad.
Fixed a crash involving chests and dressers placed on certain platforms configurations.
Fixed the last item in the Tavernkeep's shop. Tavernkeep no longer sells Town Pylons in order to accommodate his fully unlocked store.
Fixed a bug with minecart tracks that could allow you to slide on air.
Fixed several Linux issues.
